blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Representatives from polytechnic state universities and other educational institutions gathered for the launching of the Philippine Polytechnic Education Network (PhilPEN) for a more coordinated polytechnic system in the country. “Let’s work together as one polytechnic. Let us build a consortium that will advance polytechnic education, that will contribute to national progress while responding to global challenges,” Polytechnic University of the Philippines (PUP) President Dr. Manuel Muhi said in a statement released Saturday.
